Oxy- phenbutazone was used systemically in disorders such as anky- losing spondylitis, osteoarthritis, and rheumatoid arthritis but such use is no longer considered justified because of the risk of severe haematological adverse effects (see also Effects on the Blood, under Phenylbutazone, p.117).
